assets.painel/public/assets/partner-store-icons:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE square transparent icon sprite atlas for a real app.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE, especially the four embossed icons in Minha loja. Do NOT reproduce the phone or screen.
Generate a single square 2x2 icon sprite sheet, EXACTLY four icons of identical perceived size, each centered in an equally sized quadrant. Keep the entire backdrop transparent with genuine alpha. No grid lines, no labels, no typography, no cards, no smartphone, no surrounding scene. Keep every icon wholly within its own quadrant with 10% empty margins.
Top-left quadrant: realistic round brushed silver clock face with thick dark steel bezel and very thin deep forest-green trim, black raised hands showing a time, tiny understated hour marks, like the clock on the reference.
Top-right quadrant: two black embossed human silhouettes as seen on Funcionários, chrome beveled outline with a thin forest-green lower rim, black slightly brushed faces.
Bottom-left quadrant: small black embossed delivery truck facing right, chrome bevel edges, two black tires with dark green hubs and a thin dark green lower accent, like reference.
Bottom-right quadrant: black embossed loudspeaker facing right and two dark green curved sound waves, chrome bevel outline.
Material: machined satin steel, believable 3D relief, natural little shadows attached to the icons, crisp restrained polished highlights, charcoal black and very dark emerald green. Frontal orthographic view, top-left studio illumination consistent across all icons. No neon, no glow, no plastic, no cartoon, no arcade styling, no perspective rotation. Make the four icons nearly fill their respective square quadrant while keeping edges and shadows away from neighboring quadrants.
assets.painel/public/assets/partner-store-backg:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: portrait brushed steel BACKGROUND texture for a working mobile app.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE. Generate ONLY the decorative silver steel canvas INSIDE the mobile screen, no phone or bezel, no shadow outside the canvas, no UI cards, no buttons, no icons, no photos, absolutely NO TEXT.
Create a tall portrait rectilinear canvas with fine horizontal brushed stainless steel, satin metallic reflections similar to the reference and much smoother than coarse noise.
The main middle reading area must remain quiet, blank, pale silver. Add precisely the industrial decorations seen in the reference:
- At the upper right, between 10% and 28% of canvas height, a subdued medium-gray diagonal tire tread print crossing from lower-left toward upper-right, fading softly toward the center. Keep the left 60% mostly blank for real heading and operator name.
- Around 29% of height a thin etched silver seam from the left crossing most of the width and taking a short raised angular step near the right; a tiny dark forest-green inset strip follows part of this seam. At the far right edge there is a small partial arc of a brushed machined wheel ring with two restrained dark rivets, clipped by the edge.
- Do NOT add lines, plates, boxes, symbols or ornaments in the center 33%-72% of height, where real app menu cards will be laid on top.
- At the lower left, between 78% and 94% of height, another subdued diagonal gray tire tread mark, partly clipped by the left edge.
- At the lower right, between 78% and 94% of height, three thin parallel angled machined silver cuts and dark forest-green inset stripes, like reference, keep them restrained.
- At upper-left near 8% height and lower-right near 95% height include only tiny real metal rivets.
No extra text or icon artwork whatsoever; no gray checkerboard; no rounded page corners; no dramatic dark border or vignetting; no overly busy scratched/grunge metal; no neon or arcade graphics. Output a high resolution flat portrait background asset suitable to place REAL HTML text, buttons and cards over it.
